description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DummyPaymentMethod' that extends 'AbstractPaymentMethod'. It serves as a mock payment method for testing purposes, providing stub implementations for payment-related methods, including payment simulation, responses, and refund logic. The class includes methods to retrieve payment method info, handle dummy purchase flows, and generate HTML content for a simulated payment gateway.

classes.name: DummyPaymentMethod
classes.description: A mock payment method class intended solely for testing purposes, which does not perform real payment transactions but simulates responses and interactions.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dummy payment gateway, which is 'Dummy'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of this payment method, 'Dummy Payment'.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a description indicating this is a testing payment method that does nothing.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the URL string to the icon representing this payment method.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Generates an HTML page response simulating a payment gateway interface, depending on whether gateway is in simulation mode.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Simulates a purchase operation by setting the gateway in simulation mode and returning a failed response.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Handles completing a dummy purchase, setting payment details, and returning a simulated send response.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Indicates that the payment method supports refunds, returning true.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Simulates a refund operation, updating the investment amount and dispatching an refund event.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this is an internal payment method that does not increase raised amounts.
